name: English - Creative Writing C1: The Art of Craft - Toward Publication: Critical Revision Techniques
description:
In the Advanced Fiction Writing Course, students who are already familiar with the basics of narratology can further explore other fiction and non-fiction genres, the interplay between form and content and further deepen their writing abilities to achieve well-organized, rhetorically effective English prose. Students will also appraise, support and critique the literary writing of their peers in a guided workshop environment.

Revision techniques will be covered and more complex theories of literary criticism will be explored and applied to contemporary texts and their texts. Other issues related to being a writer i.e. the road to publication, the ethics of writing (cultural appropriation etc.) will also be discussed.

To this end, below are three additional components that will be included in the syllabus.

- A component on Manuscript Preparation for Publication and Revision Techniques; a transferable skill which will help prepare students for academic and non-fiction publishing too.

- A focus on the performative aspects of the writing industry including public performances and speaking (readings and discussions).
Please note that the public performances component is currently not possible due to the current Corona Virus regulations but class readings and discussions will still take place.

- An introduction to other new forms not yet covered in the introductory CW course- Forms eg. screenwriting, nature writing and / or travelogues.

Manuscript Preparation for Publication:

-	Editing – structural editing, proofreading etc.

How to write:
-	Book Blurbs
-	Reviews
-	Synopsis
-	A letter to the Editor

Editorial experience assisting in practicum with the T.U.M Sprachenzentrum English Department literary journal- Polyphony
prerequisites: Beginners and experienced creative writers are welcome.
